body: When you think of Gampola, one landmark instantly comes to mind—Ambuluwawa. But what exactly is it? Contrary to popular belief, it’s not a Buddhist monastery. Ambuluwawa is a unique multi-religious site and a breathtaking viewing point where, on a clear day, you can see the horizon stretch in every direction—360 degrees of pure magic.To enter, you’ll need to purchase tickets at the main gate. From there, it’s a 3km climb to the tower. And let me be honest—the steepness is no joke. If your vehicle isn’t built for tough terrain, it’s wiser to park and hire a tuk tuk. The ride costs around LKR 1,500 one way, and trust me, it’s worth every rupee when you consider the strain on your vehicle—or your knees.I wouldn’t recommend walking unless you’re a seasoned hiker. It’s especially important to prepare elders in your group: this isn’t a gentle pilgrimage like Sri Pada. It’s a demanding ascent, and safety should always come first.The tower itself? It’s high time it received some TLC. Renovations and better maintenance are overdue, and hopefully, the upcoming cable car project will bring much-needed upgrades. But despite the challenges, once you reach the top, every struggle melts away. The view is nothing short of magnificent—breathtaking, surreal, and soul-stirring.Please take all necessary precautions for yourself and your loved ones, especially when climbing the tower. The beauty is unforgettable, but safety is non-negotiable.
title: Ambuluwawa: Gampola’s crown Jewel

body: Visiting Ambuluwawa Tower was one of the most unforgettable highlights of my trip. Nestled on a hilltop near Gampola, this bio-diversity complex is more than just a tower – it’s a celebration of nature, culture, and adventure.The climb itself is thrilling – the spiral staircase narrows as you go higher, adding a sense of adventure and challenge. It’s not for the faint-hearted, but the reward is absolutely worth it. Once at the top, the 360-degree panoramic views are breathtaking – misty mountains, lush green valleys, tea plantations, and distant towns all spread out beneath you like a painting.What makes Ambuluwawa even more special is its bio-diversity park, home to a wide variety of trees, plants, and birdlife. It’s a peaceful reminder of Sri Lanka’s natural richness, and walking around the grounds feels refreshing and serene. The site also celebrates religious harmony, with shrines and symbols representing multiple faiths side by side.If you’re seeking a mix of nature, culture, and adventure, Ambuluwawa Tower is a must-visit. Go early in the morning or late afternoon for the best views, and be prepared for a heart-pounding but unforgettable climb to the top.
title: A Truly Unique Experience in Sri Lanka

body: Ambuluwawa Tower is truly unique and offers breathtaking views of the Sri Lankan landscape. To enjoy the experience comfortably, I would recommend visiting early in the morning or during quieter hours.Overall, Ambuluwawa Tower is a must-see for travelers looking for an adventurous and scenic stop in Sri Lanka. Located about 25 kilometers from Kandy, Ambuluwawa is known for its unique biodiversity complex and the iconic Ambuluwawa Tower.The hike begins at the base of the Ambuluwawa Mountain, where you’ll start ascending through lush greenery and diverse plant life. The trail is moderately challenging, with a mix of steep sections and gentler slopes. As you climb higher, you’ll be rewarded with stunning panoramic views of the surrounding mountains, forests, and rivers.At the summit, the Ambuluwawa Tower stands tall, offering a 360-degree view of the landscape which is breathtaking. The tower itself is a marvel, with a spiral staircase that narrows as you ascend, adding a bit of thrill to the climb. The top of the tower provides breathtaking views, making it a perfect spot for photography and simply soaking in the beauty of Sri Lanka.The entire hike, including the climb to the top of the tower, can take around 2-3 hours, depending on your pace. It’s advisable to start early in the morning to avoid the midday heat and to enjoy the serene atmosphere before the crowds arrive.

body: Ambuluwawa Tower is located in the suburbs of Gampola Town in Sri Lanka. There has been an increased popularity in recent times especially due to the breathtaking views you can experience when you climb to the top of the Ambuluwawa Tower. It is also known for its narrow spiral staircase which some visitors find challenging to climb. It is one of the coolest places to visit in Sri Lanka if you are up for the challenge.Ambuluwawa MountainAmbuluwawa mountain peak has a height of 3567 feet above sea level. It is located over 1000 feet above from the Gampola Town. The tower is located on the summit of the mountain peak. Since there are no other mountains in the surrounding area and due to its unique location, Ambuluwawa Tower gets an undisturbed view from far away and vice versa. The tower is visible from Gampola Train Station.The 48 meters tall, cone-shaped tower houses the Stupa (Pagoda) of the Buddhist Temple. As you climb up, it has several viewing platforms for you to enjoy the stunning views. The staircase gets narrower as you go up. The spiral staircase will be a challenging one to climb if you are not comfortable with heights.Ambuluwawa Biodiversity Complex is the first of its kind in Sri Lanka. It was opened in 2009. It is home to a variety of plants. It is considered as the fourth botanical garden in Sri Lanka.It is a multi-religious centre where followers of all faiths practiced in Sri Lanka come to practice their religion. It consists of a Buddhist Temple, Hindu Temple, a Church, and a Mosque.Nearest Town: GampolaYou can travel by train to visit Ambuluwawa Tower. Gampola is the nearest train station.It is advisable to hire a tuk-tuk/taxi from Gampola if you are getting there by public transport.Gates open at 8.30 am.The distance from the entrance to the mountain peak is about 2.5 -3 km. You can take your car, hire a TUK TUK or walk to the top.
title: About Ambulwawa

Don't waste your time and money on this tower or kandi.The tower does not carry any architectural, historical or semantic meaning, just another fundraiser.Going up with a tuk-tuk, the whole area stinks of urine.3 points for the view - but if you have been to other mountains, then there is no point in going there at all
title: Don't waste your time and money

body: Great situation, the hills from the base of the tower are wonderful. Climbing it be prepared to negotiate an ever narrowing staircase with a concrete balustrade handrail with a few uprights missing here and there and some gaps in the treads clearly showing the fall to certain death below. Its not well maintained to be frank. The steps are so narrow at the top its impossible to pass meaning people constantly have to go back but even that is very difficult indeed. I'm not bad with heights but didnt really like it having people trying to get past and the view downwards is dizzying. Nice coffee bar and clean toilets at the bottom.
title: Not for the Health and Safety Executive, acrophobics or claustrophobics!

body: You have to see it to believe!! The climb is thrilling but the views from top of the tower are absolutely breathtaking!🤩
title: Breathtaking beauty!

body: A good place with a view of the surrounding area. We got there first by car, then along the serpentine road in a tuk-tuk. We didn’t go to the tower itself; the panoramic area around was enough.
title: Panorama of the surrounding area

body: A very beautiful tower with a beautiful road to it. You can get to the tower from the lower parking lot by tuktuk (5 minutes). I don't recommend walking. It will take about 40 minutes uphill along the serpentine road. And then the same way down.The tower itself is beautiful. The steps at the very top are already 30-40 centimeters wide. It is very difficult to break up (thin). Apparently you won’t get all the way to the top, but 2/3 can be overcome.The views from the middle are amazing. I recommend it to everyone.
title: A very scenic place!

body: Not a safe set up. It was actually very scary and not in a good way. It would have been a Great place to visit if it were managed or developed a little better. The steps towards the top of the tower are so narrow that it’s impossible for two people to stand side by side at the same time. Even a single person can’t stand straight near the top of the tower. People have to squeeze past each other when walking up or down in opposite directions. At various instances some people simply has to fling their legs over the safety railing to allow opposite traffic to move past. Someone had to crouch down to the floor to let someone else jump over to cross into the opposite direction. The steps have been developed in a very narrow fashion and either the management needs to widen the steps or form groups that move up at a particular time and only let the next group go up when the one before has returned. Sadly there is no supervision or any remote sense of management responsibility. We went up on Christmas-25th December and I agree that there would have been heavier than usual footfall due to the holiday but that’s no excuse to put safety of visitors at risk. Yes, the view from the top is great but reaching the top was extremely uncomfortable
title: Highly avoidable on rush days

body: Very unique experience climbing this tower! view is beautiful. Since the stairs are narrow, need patience and co-operation from travelers to safely go up and down. worth a visit
title: Lovely view and fun climbing!

body: Ambuluwawa Temple is truly a unique destination, offering breathtaking views from its distinctive tower. However, visitors should be cautious. The climb to the top can be quite dangerous due to low railings, narrow staircases, and overcrowding. Additionally, starting from January 1st, the entry fee for tourists will double to 2000 LKR, which is worth considering when planning a visit. While the views are spectacular, safety and cost factors might be a concern for some visitors.
title: Stunning Yet Risky Experience at Ambuluwawa Temple

body: We stopped in here on our way from Kandy to Nuwara Eliya, out of the way but really glad we stopped here. Amazing views and something very different. The tallest part of the tower is only wide enough for one person, you have to squeeze past people on their way through so I wouldn’t recommend if you are larger or elderly.
title: Stop off

body: Last place our excursion visited tower Ambuluwawa. drove up by tuk-tuk. Wow emotions! So I’m very afraid high 🤪😳 going up the stairs my heart stopped. Marvelous views, my children were very happy, they rose to the top. I’d like repeat the experience! Of course I recommend 👍👍👍
title: Marvelous tower and incredible memories

body: A very strong experience, great views but not for the faint-hearted. The stairs are so narrow at the top that you have to lean your upper body over the railing to let someone pass. Still recommended.
title: Unusual tower with a great view

body: the view is magnificent but it is very dangerous for many people to go up and down at the same time it must be controlled by someone and a limited number of people should be sent up and each one must have time to stay there
title: Wonderful view! Like paradise

body: Ambuluwawa Tower is a biodiversity complex multi-religious sanctuary situated in the central highlands of the country. The Ambuluwawa Trigonometrical Station, in Gampola, consists of large winding tower resembling a stylized Buddhist stupa, a Hindu temple, a Muslim mosque and a Christian Church.
title: Multicutural

body: We just loved the views from this amazing tower. The architecture that’s used here is impeccable. There are caves like things where you can go and get that cave experience. When you get up to the tower the stairs become smaller. It’s a bit windy but you won’t get a better picture. Amazing
title: The view is perfect

body: An adventure not to miss. If you are into adrenaline rushes then this Dr Seuss like tower is for you. We climbed in a cloud so probably easier for us not knowing how high up we were. When the steps became so skinny no one could pass I freaked out a bit and had to come down. I think we were nearly at the top possibly a metre to go.
title: Tower of terrifying height

body: The tower is a must visit. You have to climb a lot spiral steps.As you go higher it becomes so narrow that you cannot put your full feet on tile.You will have to climb sideways.There is no platform at the top so it is a circus between people going up and people going down The view from the top is breathtaking.Keep going forward 1 step at a time.Very risky and dangerous.If you fall it is your death.The ticket is only 1000 SR per person but you will need to reach the tower base which itself is on a hill. Our driver was sneaky and took us to his friend (way before hill base) who charged 8000 SR to take us to the hill top.There are many tuk tuks available near the hill base. Bargain to get better price.You can walk aslo. But not recommended as its a climb and you will need your energy for the tower climb.
title: Must visit. Not meant for faint hearted

body: Amazing views , not for the faint hearted.. my daughter climbed the tower, I could only do the smaller tower but still lots to see in the grounds walking around.Had to get to the tower via a tuc tuc but not expensive
title: Tower

body: Great experience to climb to the top of the tower!!!It's impressive,! And it's worth the detour!If you are afraid of heights... Avoid with very young children and it is not the hardest access but the crossings between those going up and down….Also it's very very narrow the closer you get to the top... some larger people had to turn around because it was too narrow!Once at the top: magnificent and breathtaking view looking down….Try the experience!Access is free… you can go up to the entrance on foot or by tuk tuk…
title: To do: magnificent view at the top!

body: I love the uniqueness of this tower - I love the fact you can find a mosque, a church, buddhist and hindu temples at the base. The views at top are incredible but I cannot say I would do this again as it is not worth the stress caused by other people continuing to climb before waiting for others to come down. At the very top the steps are so narrow so there is not enough space for two people to pass. It is not a nice situation to put yourself in especially if you are fearful of heights and/or do not wish to drag your body against multiple strangers just to get down again. If the numbers entering the tower were controlled (e.g. timed slots) then it would make the experience much more enjoyable, and quicker (it took much longer to climb and descend as you have to wait for other people to move)!!!
title: Incredible views BUT prepare to get up close & personal with strangers who don't think to wait for others to come down!

body: Ambuluwawa tower situated in gampola, very beautiful location you can visit top of tower and capture nice pics from there, you can see 360 view
title: Ambuluwawa Tower

body: An interesting building. The climb to the top is tiring, but very worthwhile. The stairs are very narrow, and it becomes a problem with oncoming traffic. Beautiful view from the top. Go at a time when it is not too busy.
title: Don't go if you are afraid of heights

body: This was the most excruciatingly annoying thing to do to date. Unfortunately we went when an entire school proceeded up at the same time as us. The structure to climb is single file one person at a time however like most things no one has any clue and just pushes up together - we got trapped near the top because people were too stubborn to go backwards into the refuge holes available. The top was as good from 3 stories below. It sort of just stops curling around suddenly. You have to literally drag you body against someone else’s to get past. Nice thing to have ticked off but wouldn’t do again. Please note a tuk tuk up will cost you 5000 rupees or the walk is an arduous vertical climb that will take over an hour
title: It’s ok but wouldn’t rave about it

body: Best fun experience to climb the top!!!!!Super thrilling and adventurous placeJust go and experience it
title: Best adventurous climb

body: It is a wonderful structure built on a summit of a mountain range. You can enjoy an amazing 360 degree view of the magnificient central mount range of Sri Lanka. Must visit place if you are travelling across Kandy.
title: Amazing 360 degree view of the magnificient central mount range of Sri Lanka

body: I visited Ambuluwawa on a Sunday during the afternoon. It was somewhat crowded. The crowd didn't stop me enjoying the nature. There is a same Buddhist temple, a church a kovil and a mosque. Climbed the renouned Ambuluwawa tower 'The view' is breath taking. If you go by your personal vehicle you can drive passing the tickets counter at the entrance(highly recommended n make sure your vehicle is good condition you have to climb a very steep mountain). Please avoid eating in the premises because monkeys will try to snatch your food.
title: Relaxing
Exciting place to visit
body: As per the hight we thought It was kinda difficult to climb however it was not difficult climb any of the places we climb in srilanka .There is a lack of safety for kids If you are over weight person you may not be able to move from top.If you are travelling by open vehicle beware of monkeys They will steal everything when you reached to vehicle.

title: Beautiful mountains views
body: Amazing 360 degree view of the beautiful middle mountain range of Sri Lanka, not much crowded, a recently made rare shape structure .

title: Great place
body: we want to get this amazing experience so we climb top the tower ,actually it's not easy we was fear.not easy to climb top .at the top it s narrow .but finnaly we did.so after we see the down oh it s amazing view .

title: WOW
body: The road itself to go up there is astonishing for its natural beauty, so as the landscape you will enjoy from the tower. Climbing up to the top of the tower is not for everyone, not only for the many steps, but for the fact that it really challenges the fear of heights, since there is not much protection. Moreover, in the last bit of the tower the passage is very very narrow, so you need to be slim/small to fit it. This said, you don’t need to get to the top to enjoy the beauty of this place, so if you stop before the end, your visit will be more than worth anyway.

title: Unforgettable place
body: Ambuluwawa is the one of the most amazing place in sri lanka...It is located to the gampola town...The feeling of climbing that tower more fun

title: Ambuluwawa Tower
body: Ambuluwawa Tower is located in the suburbs of Gampola Town Sri Lanka.It is a bio diversity complex as well as the first multi religious shrine in sri lanka.We can see a temple,kovil,mosque and a church.As we ascend the stairs,the width of the stairs decreases and it takes on a spiral shape.Reaching the top of Ambuluwawa we can experience the most amazing views which could sometimes be covered by the ongoing mist.It has several viewing platforms for to enjoy the stunning views.When we climb to the top of this tower,we can see Adam's peak,Knuckles range,Bagathale rock,Piduruthalagala mountain.This is an awesome experience I had ever experienced.

title: Amazing View
body: It was easy to climb and no scarier if you behave well. just climb up and climb down. Do not try to hang on the staircase to get selfies. It is a wonderful place. Cheers!

title: Breathtaking
body: this tower is awesome. it's sooooo much fun!!!!i thought it would be scary but it really wasn't. the building is stong and easy to climb. just make sure you watch your step and hang on and you'll be fine. the view from up there is stunning.accessing the tower itself is free, getting there we had to hire this tiny care that resembled a golf car. it was very fun and the drivers were racing each other up the mountain and it was hilarious.10/10.
